rules: A generated draft is not a published log entry.
Official drafts may use only authorized factual sources and must preserve uncertainty.
Personal-log drafts may express subjective interpretation but may not grant the author knowledge they did not have.
The AI must not invent events to make a log more dramatic or complete.
The author may dictate verbatim and bypass stylistic rewriting.
The original voice recording may be retained separately from the approved transcript when configured.
Approval must be attributable to the author or authorized institutional signer.
